LogEx connection-limits patch provenance

Published package: libp2p-connection-limits 0.6.0
Archive SHA-256: a18b8b607cf3bfa2f8c57db9c7d8569a315d5cc0a282e6bfd5ebfc0a9840b2a0
Upstream VCS: 7b9a558e3188eaf20a14bd8388d5e9b6e2aa9a23

All six published files, including original manifests, lockfile, source license
notice and changelog, are retained. LOGEX-UPSTREAM-SHA256 records original bytes;
LOGEX-PATCH.diff records the complete local change. The shared vendor verifier
checks source provenance offline. Implementation and validation summaries live
in the implementation pull request.

The normalized published manifest omitted the original test dependencies
libp2p-swarm-derive, libp2p-swarm-test and quickcheck. They are restored as
pinned development dependencies so the original library tests and finite LogEx
connection-lifecycle controls can run together. Production dependencies and
public limits/errors are unchanged.

The original property-test generator uses a private QuickCheck method; the
local test-only adaptation chooses from the same values through its public API.
